description: Source code for QpackBlockingManager class managing header block acknowledgements, stream cancellations, insert count increments, and stream blocking logic in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QpackBlockingManager
classes.description: Manages QPACK header blocking state, including acknowledgements, stream cancellations, insert count increments, and stream blocking permissions.

methods.name: OnHeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of header blocks for a stream, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: OnStreamCancellation
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a stream, cleaning up associated header blocks.

methods.name: OnInsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Increments the known received count, ensuring no overflow occurs.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockSent
methods.description: Records that a header block has been sent for a stream, increasing reference counts.

methods.name: blocking_allowed_on_stream
methods.description: Determines if blocking is allowed on a given stream based on current header block state and maximum blocked streams.

methods.name: smallest_blocking_index
methods.description: Returns the smallest index currently blocking header processing.
